payload.text: **0063 -- the HIGH issue, hv wants it done asap. Building next, from cc's design.** The design is cc's board todo 1 (`intent wb show cc`) and the issue's own 2026-09-09 amendment (`intent issues show 0063`): `command_option_candidates` becomes the one enumeration and `command_options` filters it by `option_active`; `run_all` refuses a verdict unless ran + skipped(in_all) + inactive == candidates, and prints ONE count line on every path (`N of M options ran; K inactive (...)`), naming members only on refusal. Compute inactive from `option_active` on each candidate, never from `command_options`. The denominator is the deduplicated union `command_options` builds, NOT `lib/builtins` (empty under a project handler). Vehicles: `enabled: false`; `test` in a project declaring no languages; a project handler; a unit stub dropping an active option. cc's `||`-fallback question (todo 29) is decided here. Work in a separate git worktree if a suite is running in the main tree. cc reviews 0062 and 0063 on return.
